text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
—I won't hesitate anymore. There are 
people whose happiness only I can bring!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So that I can make everyone who's waiting 
for me truly happy with the power of Feng 
Shui!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Before we face the big showdown 
at the February Stakes, let's go boost our 
luck to the max☆

Uniting our minds as one, we decided to 
visit every single place we could think 
of.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Phew, that was such a nice bath~♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
First, like this, we cleanse ourselves at 
the super sento south of Tracen Academy—☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the Hachimi stand♪ Today's 
lucky color is "Lavender"! Sooo...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Let's load up on nutrients and invite some 
good luck with "Lavender Hachimi Yogurt"!

The two of us chugged down the supersized 
drinks. And then—
(WOOOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"The big day's finally here, Tarumae-chan. 
Is this your first February Stakes?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's one of the greatest races that 
all dirt Umamusume strive for. But...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"I will definitely win! After all, I am 
the Tomakomai Tourism Ambassador!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I swore upon this precious sash I received 
when leaving my hometown that I would 
return in glory!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
“Wait... huh? Come to think of it, where's 
Rickey...?”

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting, Tarumae☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'm going all out today! So be ready to 
take me on♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huh... Rickey. Th-that's kind of...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Are you, by any chance, feeling super 
energetic? Um..."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, because I realized it. Hesitation in 
the heart only leads to hesitation in my 
running. For me—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
There is someone who believes in me! There 
is someone I can believe in! And that 
someone is—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Because you taught me to "just believe in 
myself and keep moving forward."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Benefactors and seniors like that are part 
of the environment too —which means 
they're part of feng shui, you know?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I am surrounded by such warm, 
powerful goodwill. That is why—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine now! I'll prove I'm right through 
my own running!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"If I were putting my efforts in the wrong 
direction, there's no way I'd be able to 
stand shoulder to shoulder with the 
Tarumae of today."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Rickey...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right. In the end, we have no 
choice... but to show it with our running.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Come on, bring it! I'll show you through 
my running just how deeply and strongly I 
cherish my hometown, too!

"Her rivals are Hokko Tarumae in her 
prime, and the seasoned veteran Wonder 
Acute. The strongest lineup in history. 
Even so—"

Copano Rickey finally gained the 
confidence that she wouldn't lose. Her 
Senior Year, and the first and biggest 
showdown of it all, was about to begin.
